description: Scripted Mac clients on other easl versions (client.attach): one built from an older schema version is refused `unavailable` and serves nothing; one with the server's version and another schema hash, and one built from a newer version, are accepted and serve the methods both sides know. easld ignores the attach params and `serves` names it doesn't know and never sends a client a method it doesn't list. easld only: the app doesn't speak the client protocol yet.

steps.note: a schema version older than the server's: refused, so it never attaches
the refused client serves nothing: no client shows the board

ignore.response.result.schema: the server's schema hash changes with every schema edit

steps.note: the server's version and another schema hash: accepted; `windows` and view.zoom are unknown here and ignored
the client doesn't list view.snapshot: it isn't sent one

ignore.response.result.schema: the server's schema hash changes with every schema edit

steps.note: a schema version newer than the server's: accepted, and the reply names the server's version for the client to speak
the newer client focuses the board, so it serves view.get
the newer client doesn't list view.render: the client that does serves it
